description: This file defines the ExternalAppendOnlyMap class, a spillable, append-only map used in Spark for efficient sorting and spilling of large datasets during shuffles. It includes mechanisms for in-memory merging, disk spilling, and merging sorted data from multiple sources.

classes.name: ExternalAppendOnlyMap
classes.description: A spillable, append-only map that merges data in memory and spills to disk when necessary, used for sorting and merging large datasets in Spark shuffle operations.

classes.name: ExternalAppendOnlyMap.HashComparator
classes.description: Comparator that sorts keys based on their hash codes for merging.

classes.name: ExternalAppendOnlyMap.DiskMapIterator
classes.description: Iterator for reading spilled map data from disk in sorted order.

classes.name: ExternalAppendOnlyMap.SpillableIterator
classes.description: Iterator that supports spilling in-memory data to disk and provides a completion-aware iteration.

classes.name: ExternalAppendOnlyMap.StreamBuffer
classes.description: Buffer for streaming sorted key-value pairs from a map iterator, used in merge operations.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Insert a key-value pair into the map.

methods.name: insertAll
methods.description: Insert multiple key-value pairs from an iterator or iterable into the map.

methods.name: spill
methods.description: Sort and spill the current in-memory map to disk.

methods.name: forceSpill
methods.description: Force spilling of in-memory data to disk to free memory.

methods.name: spillMemoryIteratorToDisk
methods.description: Serialize and write an in-memory iterator to disk as a spill.

methods.name: destructiveIterator
methods.description: Create a destructive iterator over in-memory or spilled data.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Get an iterator over all data, merging in-memory and spilled data if necessary.

methods.name: freeCurrentMap
methods.description: Release in-memory map resources for garbage collection.

methods.name: hashKey
methods.description: Hash function for keys used in merging.
